719-4863-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-4863-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

803-3510-4288-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-4288-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2707-3617-5498.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1894-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2999-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

280-1558-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2557-4659-5346-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Parallel Lives.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

628-6797-7212.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

893-2981-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2173-2438-5220-5933.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2364-3767-3918-4452.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2364-3767-3918-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
2364-3767-3918-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-1789-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

573-804-1479.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

3000-5670-5708.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

186-237-1812-2034-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orzhov Enforcer, adding {C}{C}.
When Orzhov Enforcer dies, its afterlife ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {3}{B}, returning Orzhov Enforcer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2354-3862-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2354-3862-4871.description:
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing all Armies you control, or one other creature if you don't control an Army.
When the sacrificed creature(s) die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers that many times, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve Krav's ability, causing an opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life for each creature sacrificed this way, and for you to put that many +1/+1 counters on Krav.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn this way, dealing that much damage to any target and causing you to gain that much life, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on it for each card drawn.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

647-1379-2210-3259-4248.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Harnessed Snubhorn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-1379-2210-3259-4248.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Harnessed Snubhorn, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Harnessed Snubhorn trigger, returning Mirrormade from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harnessed Snubhorn.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Harnessed Snubhorn, then attach Breath of Fury to Mirrormade, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Mirrormade, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Mirrormade trigger, returning Harnessed Snubhorn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Mirrormade, then attach Breath of Fury to Harnessed Snubhorn, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.

2097-3398-3809.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Goldspan Dragon and Hellkite Charger.
2097-3398-3809.description:
Declare Goldspan Dragon and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger, Goldspan Dragon, and Jolene triggers.
Resolve the Goldspan Dragon and Jolene triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

479-3304-5209.notablePrerequisites:
You have exactly one card in hand.
Your library size is at least fifteen.
479-3304-5209.description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing Worldspine Wurm.
Worldspine Wurm dies, triggering its first and second ability.
Resolve the first Worldspine Wurm trigger, creating three 5/5 Wurm creature tokens.
Resolve the second Worldspine Wurm trigger, shuffling it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw fifteen cards and discard three cards.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

654-1021-1315-2713.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.

2744-3192-4929.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2744-3192-4929.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
